infoLinks.content:
From 12.01am until 11.59pm on Saturday 21 February, route 947 services will be diverting and using alternative stops while road closures are in place for Lunar New Year celebrations in Hurstville. 

Services travelling to Hurstville will divert into Barratt Street and end trips at Hurstville Station, Barratt St, Stand E (2220329). 
 
Services leaving Hurstville will start trips at Westfield Hurstville, Cross St (2220301) and divert via Crofts Avenue, Barratt Street, Dora Street,
Queens Road and The Ave to return to route on Forest Road. An additional stop will be made at Hurstville Station, Barratt St, Stand E (2220329). 
 
Check signs at bus stops for alternative stop locations and allow extra travel time.  
 
Missed stops: 
  • Hurstville Station, Stand A (2220328) 
  • Westfield Hurstville, Forest Rd (222023)
